original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚陆军否认三角洲检查站事件中的勒索指控
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚陆军第63旅否认了有关其在三角洲州伊布萨检查站实施勒索和袭击的指控，称社交媒体上流传的视频具有误导性。军方表示，事件发生在11月3日晚约10时，当时部队因当地发生邪教相关暴力而设立临时检查站，并称士兵在应对安全局势时行为专业。目前该说法仅来自军方单一方面，相关指控尚未获得独立证实。

location.raw_text: Ibusa, Oshimili North Local Government Area of Delta State

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚陆军第63旅否认了有关勒索和袭击的指控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Headquarters 63 Brigade ... has denied allegations of extortion and assault against its personnel following a checkpoint incident in Ibusa

key_facts.fact: 事件发生在三角洲州伊布萨的检查站
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a checkpoint incident in Ibusa, Oshimili North Local Government Area of Delta State

key_facts.fact: 军方称事件发生在11月3日晚约10时，起因是当地邪教相关暴力报告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident occurred at about 10 pm on November 3, following reports of cult-related violence in the area

key_facts.fact: 军方将流传的社交媒体视频称为误导性内容
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Brigade described a viral video circulating on social media about the incident as misleading

uncertainties: 勒索和袭击指控尚未获得独立证实
